cmake.description: Configures a CMake build tree with its configure invocation, then runs the cmake, ctest, and clang tool invocations of the target in order, stopping at the first failure

package.description: Configures the packaging workflow's build tree, builds the project's targets from its manifest as it stands, and packs the project's install tree with CPack into a staging folder, then replaces the output folder with the package files CPack named from the project name, version, system, and processor
